summary: A 13.6 m tri-axle semi-trailer: the OTHER HALF of an articulated lorry. joints door_l, door_r, landing_gear, landing_gear_r, wheel_a0_l_roll, wheel_a0_r_roll, …; options body, paint; sockets socket_kingpin, socket_deck, socket_seal, socket_rear.
